measurement_provenance.provenance: All six arms measure the unchanged #70 lane 2 firmware for the census #629 grows (the CLOCK_SOURCE NAME records of the AAF listeners), at processor pin b2db3a97. The census each row must copy is derived from the generated shape through nvm_shape.closed_record_census. The six arms ran in parallel from the tree of a2f17342. A first run at 62822ca6, before the meter's port split and the TX-trace fix, reproduced every capture's cycle count in the five arms it graded; its 8x8 OFF arm could not be graded, a TX trace having split a CAPTURE row, which a2f17342 fixes. The capture SoC has no Milan MAC MDIO CSR, so the PHY path is compiled out. ARM through ATTEST contains no heartbeat or PHY call.
